title: 4Dflow-VP-Net: A deep convolutional neural network for noninvasive estimation of relative pressures in stenotic flows from 4D flow MRI
summary: 4Dflow-VP-Net estimates relative pressure gradients from 4D-flow MRI; comparison with catheter/Doppler and in vitro/in vivo data supports the bounded measurement result. First publication date 2023-07-26 is corroborated by the primary bibliographic entry. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
organization: Medical Imaging Lab, Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, University of Louisville, Louisville, Kentucky, USA
